Episode 151. Situation Summary (1)
(The horrifying and abhorrent truth of the Vermont Royal Family - About the White Stone, and living golems.
Since the monster known as the King of the Black Sea awakened, the empire has been experiencing the darkest and most horrifying spring in its history.
By now, everyone should be aware that the White Stone held by Hairan was indeed the King of the Black Sea.

It's also a fact that Hairan has been guarding alone against the awakening of the White Stone for a very long time. Hairan was always wary that someone might covet this uncontrollable monstrous power and spread calamity across the world, as it is happening now.

This fact has been confirmed by the recent declaration of regency by Dante Hairan, the head of the Hairan family, who released private documents and records. Duke Talaris Endorma, the ruler of Hidden Palace, also released records about the White Stone and lent his support to prove Hairan's innocence.

We would like to express our deep gratitude to Duke Talaris, who, despite her neutrality, has been dedicated to revealing the information of Hidden Palace and battling Gliek, in order to alleviate the danger faced by the whole world as a member of humanity.
The former emperor, Amir Vermont, and the royal family who were killed by the people's stones.
Who could have predicted that the imperial royal family would commit the act that Hairan had been worried about? They even practically sold the empire to Gliek to gain the power of the White Stone.
Why were they so obsessed with the power of the White Stone?
While the empire has always been closer to Gliek, they've also maintained stable relations with other major forces, including Runcandel, through diplomacy.
There was no need to gamble, especially when it meant giving up the safety of the people of the empire to obsess over the White Stone.

Even if the royal family had successfully seized the White Stone and harnessed its power, there was no guarantee that the empire would surpass the major families, and the world would have been engulfed in the crisis of a major war.
Then, of course, the ones who would suffer the most would be the people of the empire.
Despite this, it is speculated that Amir Vermont was obsessed with the White Stone because of the 'Living Golem'.
Amir Vermont had a plan to complete the research on the Living Golem, which was secretly being conducted in the royal family, using the power of the White Stone, and mass-produce it.
The evidence was released today.
The person who submitted the evidence is Jin Runcandel, the 12th of Runcandel.
As everyone knows, Duke Jin revealed the truth about the living golem during the Holy Kingdom incident, alerting the world to its malice and danger.
Again, Duke Jin proved himself right. The royal family's greed to mass-produce the living golems is ultimately contaminating the world with chaos.
Living Golems are created from living organisms, including humans. This horrifying method is as brutal as black magic that disrupts life force.
The living golem named 'Mine' by the royal family was no exception to this method.
Moreover, it was reported that each of the royal family's 'Mine' that Duke Jin personally experienced had combat power exceeding that of a 9-star knight and possessed super regenerative abilities.)
The royal family aimed to mass-produce such mines by the thousands, even tens of thousands, to seize control of the world.
Then there is one strange point.
If they wanted to seize power, the fact that they 'sold' the empire to Zipfel for the white stone is not explained.

Zipfel attempted various negotiations with Jin Kyung during the first match of the Sword Emperor's War. He even suggested that if he gave the white stone, he would restore the then-sealed Dante Duke to its original state and destroy the empire.
Regarding that problem, Jin Kyung clarified in an interview.

-Perhaps the emperor first borrowed Zipfel's power to obtain the white stone, and planned to betray Zipfel after mass-producing the mines. If he could mass-produce the mines, he would have thought that there was a chance of winning a war against Zipfel.
Above all, the emperor knew exactly what the white stone was. Unlike us, Runcandel, or Zipfel, he was aware from the beginning that it was the King of Chaos, Gliek….
According to Jin Kyung's interview, the emperor coveted the white stone knowing everything and planned to betray Zipfel.
This reporter expects that Jin Kyung's opinion was not wrong, and thinks that it is time for the entire empire, including the royal family, to reconsider the values that Hairan has upheld.)
Evidence of the corpse of the mine was put forward, and new articles began to be written and distributed immediately.
The royal family members and pro-royal nobles who saw the article unanimously cursed and expressed their grievances.
“Royal Secretary Barkham Duke, are the recent articles really true!? Please tell us!”
“Did the previous emperor know the identity of the white stone from the beginning?”
"Did the royal family, knowing that this disaster could hit the world by Gliek, condone the emperor's tyranny?"
Secretary Barkham repeatedly shook his head with a ghastly face.
"No, His Majesty… no, I, the former emperor."
"His Majesty? What is this crazy writer saying now!"
“I, the former emperor, have never shared related information with the royal family. Even I, the secretary, didn't know anything about the mineification.”

"There is talk that the bio-golem, the corpse of the mine that is currently presented as evidence, belongs to the royal guard. Among the grotesque chunks of flesh, there were a golden guard badge and a blood-soaked pure white coat, and it was revealed that they were not fake. Please tell us about this too."
"Is the corpse of the mine the royal guard?"
The reporters and people who flocked to the palace were murmuring at his words.
It should never have been the case to use knights who have been loyal to the royal family more than anyone else as mere experimental subjects.
“Uh, we're still figuring out why the royal guard's items were mixed in with that flesh, but this is manipulation....”

"Manipulation! Sir Jin Runcandel risked his life to warn of the dangers of bio-golems even during the Holy Kingdom incident. He also helped Hairan in this war without any compensation, just out of duty! What reason would such a person have to manipulate evidence?”

“If Sir Jin and Duke Dante want to finish off the royal family, it is entirely possible by force. Duke Dante has already demonstrated his power in the square and proved this. On the other hand, what about the royal family? No relation to the emperor, don't know why the royal guard's items are there. Just words. Give a proper explanation!”
"Hmm, hm-hm! I'll stop here for today. Instead, the royal family will clarify this matter through a statement and distribution of articles within three hours, so please step back....”
As Barkham said, new reports poured out three hours later, and the royal family issued a statement.
There was no special content to turn the situation around. All they could do was repeat that they were not involved and didn't know, just in slightly more organized sentences.
It was no different for the royal family to come out in such a way.
Public anger was bound to subside at some point. Above all, the mine corpse brought by Jin could not provide decisive evidence of the connection between the royal family and the emperor on its own.
This was because no documents or witnesses about those who participated and contributed to the mine research had appeared.
They claimed that the royal guard's badge and pure white coat were coincidences, or manipulations through the belongings of the royal guard who died in this war.
Except for Jin and Valeria, no one had seen the royal guard turn into a mine in the Wanta Ramo Forest last September.
The royal family was completely unaware of the existence of a person named 'Valeria Hister'. The fact that such evasion was of no use as long as she existed.
Valeria has been finding out the location of the royal family's 'mine research institute' by applying record magic to the mine corpse.
The royal family had boldly set up and operated a research lab in the capital of the empire, not in the outlands.
As soon as the royal family's statement was issued, Jin's newsletters immediately disclosed the location of the lab.
Of course, the lab was closed, and all related people had fled as soon as the war was over and the emperor was dead.
But they had no time to clean up properly.
It was impossible to demolish it because it was located right in the middle of the empire, and above all, the royal family did not intend to completely eradicate the lab.
Mine research is now the last lifeline left for the royal family.
Since no one has found the location of the lab so far, the royal family had planned to restart it once the world calmed down a bit.
Thanks to Jin receiving the location from Valeria and making it public, even that has now turned to nothing.

"I had no idea they would find out the location of the mine research lab through the mine corpses. Talk about not seeing what's under your nose, those crazy bastards. They had a lab right in the middle of the imperial capital."
Jin said, sipping from the teacup in front of him.
Valeria was sitting in front of him. She found the second star of Hairan without disguise, meaning that she trusts Jin's colleagues to some extent now.
Jin and his colleagues fought in this war not for personal gain, but for the protection of the world. This resonated with something in the dry and cold interior of Valeria.

"I didn't expect the people to trust you so much, Jin Runcandel. Originally, mining and bio-golems are fundamentally different, but nobody says that an investigation is needed for that because you said so."

"The people obviously have no choice, and the royal family will deny it, but there's nothing to do about it. Now that journalists, people, and even the personnel of each faction are pouring into the lab, they can no longer deny it. The evidence we deliberately left will greet the angry people."

Although the royal family and their mine researchers managed to get most of the important data out in the rush, they left the lab with relatively minor documents, such as lists of participants and donors, left behind.
Jin deliberately left it so that people could see it, and the names of many royal family officials were written on those documents.
"And, the mining conducted by the royal family is different from the old dark magic mining."
At Jin's bitter voice, Valeria nodded.

"Yes. I was able to find out by examining the records of the mine corpse. What the imperial royal family is studying is definitely mining, but it's no different from a bio-golem experiment. So your claim to call the mining research a bio-golem research is not actually a lie."
Originally, mining and bio-golems are differentiated by whether the human body and living organisms are used or not.
Mining is magic, and bio-golem is closer to magic engineering.
However, the mining research that the royal family was conducting had both attributes at the same time.
"......because the physical body of your ancestor, Temar Runcandel, was used in the mining."
